end.summary:
Practised making one mark for each object to keep track without numbers.
Practised matching marks back to objects by moving or crossing off each item.
Initially made marks together without linking them to individual sheep.
Later used the one-mark-per-object method and identified a leftover mark in an example.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Parth practised keeping track of objects by making one mark for each item, then moving each item aside or crossing it off. They first mixed up the marks because they were made together, but later used the one-mark-per-object method and found the extra mark. At home, try matching small groups of toys or spoons with one mark per object, moving each item aside as you mark it.
